records.label: Change within the trained app task
records.interpretation: Local learning only; not evidence of broader transfer by itself.

records.label: Change on separate G Track attention measures
records.interpretation: Near-transfer evidence when protocol and timing are comparable.

records.label: Change on the G Track complex-span-style measure
records.interpretation: Broader working-memory transfer outcome; exact implementation remains provisional.

records.label: Change on the G Track visual-binding measure
records.interpretation: Binding transfer outcome; exact implementation remains provisional.

records.label: Change on the OMIB Matrix Reasoning Benchmark
records.interpretation: Farther-transfer benchmark; not an official IQ change score.

records.label: Comparability of cognitive/vigilance context across measurement sessions
records.interpretation: Contextualises scores; does not identify the cause of a state pattern.

records.label: Detection of unsupported or weakly sourced claims
records.interpretation: Task-specific workflow outcome requiring a defined test protocol.

records.label: Source-attribution error rate
records.interpretation: Measures whether claims, evidence or roles remain correctly bound to context.

records.label: Time required to recover task context after interruption
records.interpretation: Requires a versioned workflow simulation or field measure.

records.label: Errors or omissions when reconstructing context after handoff
records.interpretation: Team/process outcome; should not be attributed solely to individual capacity.

records.label: Time required for a defined review stage
records.interpretation: Interpret jointly with review quality; faster is not always better.

records.label: Rate of work returned for correction
records.interpretation: May reflect person, task, process or organisational causes.

records.label: Completion of the defined workflow or programme
records.interpretation: Engagement or implementation outcome, not cognitive efficacy alone.

records.label: Completion of scheduled programme activities
records.interpretation: Implementation outcome; must not be equated with effectiveness.

records.label: Practitioner or staff time required for review
records.interpretation: Operational outcome requiring accurate time accounting.

records.label: Fresh outcome evidence after a defined delay
records.interpretation: Stronger persistence evidence than same-session success.
